metadata.description: One place to install web design, motion, 3D and analysis skills for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: design-core
plugins.description: The core web design toolkit: Impeccable, UI UX Pro Max and Anthropic's frontend-design, plus a design-director skill and three Claude Code agents (design-director, design-reviewer, reference-analyst) that choose the right skills, check how a built page renders, and study reference sites.

plugins.name: motion
plugins.description: GreenSock's official GSAP skills for web animation: core API, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, React, utilities and performance.

plugins.name: threejs
plugins.description: 33 Three.js skills for ambitious 3D and WebGL work: procedural geometry and materials, water, clouds, atmosphere, shadows, cameras, post-processing, game systems and visual QA.

plugins.name: web-visuals
plugins.description: Slides, UI demos, dashboards and front-end patterns for building and presenting web interfaces.

plugins.name: ai-site-brand
plugins.description: Higgsfield's website builder and brand-kit skills. They need the Higgsfield CLI and a Higgsfield account, and they chain with Higgsfield's image and video skills, which are not included.

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer shipped software, web bundles and live pages with REA. This is the skill only: REA's own tools are installed separately with its setup command.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Turn vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Google Chrome's modern web platform guidance for coding agents.

plugins.name: floorplan
plugins.description: Draws an interactive map of how a codebase fits together.

plugins.name: craft-anything
plugins.description: Evidence-first investigation of how shipped software works, through the Craft Anything MCP tools. This is the skill only: the Windows app and its MCP server are downloaded from the Craft Anything project.

plugins.name: open-motion
plugins.description: Setup and usage guide for OpenMotion, an open-source AI-native motion graphics runtime with an MCP server. This hub's own wrapper: OpenMotion itself is installed from its repository.
